title: Stalk functor for sheaves of modules on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $x\in X$. The stalk functor $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_{X,x})$ sends an $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ to its stalk $M_x$ with its $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module structure, and a morphism $\varphi$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules to the induced $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map $\varphi_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]; it preserves identities, composition and zero morphisms. Applied degreewise, it sends a cochain complex $K^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] to the stalk complex $K_x^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules.
